en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5063 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who accuses his wife (of adultery).
Imam (as) said: "He is to be flogged."

I asked: "What if she pardons him?"
Imam (as) said: "No, and no honor (for him)."
